facts.text: I am planning a family dinner this weekend.
I need recipe ideas for comfort food dishes that are easy to make and can serve a crowd.
I am thinking of making lasagna for the family dinner.
I do not have a lot of time to prepare the lasagna.
I am inviting family members I have not seen in a while, including my aunt and her family.
I want to catch up with my aunt and her family.
My grandmother passed away three months ago.
I want to share memories of my grandmother at the family dinner.
I plan to set up a small table with photos and mementos of my grandmother.
I plan to make a slideshow with pictures of my grandmother.
I want suggestions on how to organize the slideshow, including how many pictures to include and how long it should be.
I plan to organize the slideshow chronologically.
I plan to include a mix of old and new photos in the slideshow.
I plan to add captions to make the slideshow more personal.
I want suggestions for music for the slideshow.
My grandmother loved classical music and old show tunes.
I plan to use Chopin's Nocturnes for the slideshow.
I think Chopin's Nocturnes are calming and soothing.
Chopin's Nocturnes remind me of my grandmother's love for classical music.
I want suggestions for slideshow captions.
I am deciding whether to add quotes or simple descriptions of the photos for the captions.

keyphrases: grandmother passed away three months ago
